summary: Learn to manage satellite, drone, and field data for compliance and monitoring. Build practical evidence workflows. Enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Geospatial data management helps GIS analysts and planning, environmental, infrastructure, and resource teams turn location data into traceable evidence for decisions. The course covers assessing data quality, documenting metadata and processing history, validating satellite, drone, and field data, and preparing evidence for compliance and planning reviews.
audienceIntro: Geospatial data management is relevant to professionals who collect, govern, interpret, or act on location-based evidence across project and operational settings. The course is designed for GIS analysts, programme managers, natural resource officers, agribusiness teams, infrastructure planners, and adjacent specialists who need reliable environmental and planning data.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with maps, spatial datasets, or field-based project reporting is recommended. You do not need advanced GIS programming, remote-sensing mathematics, or coding experience. Basic experience with spreadsheets and digital file management will help you complete the exercises. The course presents AI-assisted classification, STAC, OGC API Features, and automated validation at conceptual or operational application level rather than production engineering depth.
